findings.message: Stage "Blending" (S-BLEND) has no line or room clearance step; each stage starts with clearance (GMP-STAGE-CLEARANCE; PR-03)

Step p-blend-status uses block G-09@1 (Equipment status (manual attestation)), which runs only in the sandbox: it records a person's attestation where GMP needs the equipment, room and cleaning status from site services, which arrives in Phase 3. A GMP batch can never run on it (ENG-DEF-SANDBOX-ONLY; DI-05, INV-18) (ENG-DEF-SANDBOX-ONLY; DI-05, INV-18)

Step p-disp-bal uses block G-09@1 (Equipment status (manual attestation)), which runs only in the sandbox: it records a person's attestation where GMP needs the equipment, room and cleaning status from site services, which arrives in Phase 3. A GMP batch can never run on it (ENG-DEF-SANDBOX-ONLY; DI-05, INV-18) (ENG-DEF-SANDBOX-ONLY; DI-05, INV-18)

Step p-disp-clear uses block G-10@1 (Clearance checklist), which runs only in the sandbox: it records a person's attestation where GMP needs the equipment, room and cleaning status from site services, which arrives in Phase 3. A GMP batch can never run on it (ENG-DEF-SANDBOX-ONLY; DI-05, INV-18) (ENG-DEF-SANDBOX-ONLY; DI-05, INV-18)
Dispensing step p-disp-exc reads a target but has no tolerance: the dispensed total is shown against the target but not checked (G07-TOLERANCE-MISSING; PR-19) (G07-TOLERANCE-MISSING; PR-19)
